row: Dr. Thompson and the staff at Catalyst Chiropractic and Rehab provide a thorough approach to the evaluation and treatment of pain and injuries. This ensures comprehensive and specialized care. Our goal is to treat each patient individually, using cutting edge treatment modalities and protocols. This approach allows us to provide a specialized and personalized treatment plan including a full spectrum of treatment options. Whatever your injury, whatever your source of pain, you can benefit from a visit to Catalyst Chiropractic and Rehab.
